summary: Bladex, Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, signed by CFO Annette van Hoorde de Sol on November 12, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situations event is disclosed; the exhibit comprises statements of financial position, profit or loss, comprehensive income, changes in equity, and cash flows. Total assets rose to $16.48 billion from $12.79 billion at year-end 2025. Nothing here is actionable for event-driven or risk-arbitrage analysis.
